items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, preserve private and parked launch gates, and permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.
